# Cyber GRC Agent Skills

> Portable, provider-neutral AI agent skills for cyber governance, risk & compliance: 21 task skills, 19 framework packs, 26 regulation packs, crosswalks, workflows, templates, and personas — plain markdown in the Agent Skills format (SKILL.md + progressive-disclosure references).

Load a persona from agents/ as the system prompt, the matching skills/<name>/SKILL.md for the task, and only the context/ files the skill links to. Do not bulk-load the repository; follow links on demand. Never fabricate compliance facts; respect each file's "Last reviewed" date and verification footer.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what's inside, quick start per provider
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): operating rules for agents using this library
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): the three-layer model and design principles
